target_customer: Structural steel fabricators, erectors and estimators in the US
problem: Steel estimators price multimillion-dollar projects by marking up paper or PDF blueprints by hand, which is slow.
product_category: AI takeoff and estimating for structural steel

founders.name: Emmett Goodman
founders.background_notes: Chemical engineering and GenAI background per YC bio

founders.name: Victor Miller
founders.background_notes: Chemical engineer; led eight-figure infrastructure projects at Shell per YC bio

technical_complexity.rationale: Detecting beams, columns and joists on drawings with vision models and generating takeoffs is standard applied ML with domain-specific hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with Tekla, Bluebeam and Excel and fabricator workflows add some stickiness, but competitors such as Steel Genie offer similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Steel Genie from Allplan/SDS2 exists as an AI takeoff product by 2026; no dated evidence of incumbents copying Alkali specifically.

market_need_then: Estimating is still described as manual in vendor content; Alkali's site claims 2,500+ steel projects and >10% of US steel (company claim, unverified).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and benefit-focused ('Cut your takeoff time in half')

brand_strength.rationale: No sources about the brand. The name suits the earlier chemical-process product more than steel estimating, a possible mismatch, but no source says so.

pivots.from: ProcessMate, AI copilot for chemical process design (YC launch post)
pivots.why: Not stated; date and reason unverified, inferred only from two conflicting YC pages

outcome_analysis: Alkali entered YC in Spring 2025 as a chemical-process AI copilot and now sells steel estimating software, claiming 2,500+ projects. It appears to have repositioned within months, but the timing and reason are unsourced. Funding is unknown, so there is no outcome to judge yet.
notes: Pivot is inferred: YC launch post covers chemical ProcessMate (no steel mention) while the company page and site cover steel; treat as unverified. Competitors left empty: only 2025-2026 vendor pages found, nothing dated before the batch. Traction claims are company's own. Funding not found.
